Perfect! **Rxh3+** is the clearly best move. White wins the pawn immediately and gives check, forcing Black's king to move. White is up material (rook vs rook+pawn becomes rook vs rook after Rxh3+, so White is up the pawn). The main line continues Rxh3+ Kg4 (or Kg5) Rg3+ and White has a winning endgame.

**Best move:** Rxh3+

**Main line:** Rxh3+ Kg4 Rg3+ Kf4 (or Kh5/Kf5/Kh4) Ra3 Rg8 (trying to create counterplay) Ra4+ and White's rook dominates

**Motif:** hangingPiece / attraction

**Coaching note:**
Black's h3 pawn is attacked by your rook and defended only by the king. The key insight: **capture with check** (Rxh3+). This forces the king to move away and you win the pawn cleanly. Black can't recapture because the king must get out of check first. Look for moves that accomplish two things at once—here you win material AND give check, controlling the outcome.
